name: Button Group
blurb: Buttons welded into one control - the interior corners square off and the shared edges collapse to a single line.
mechanism: `:first-child` and `:last-child` round only the outer ends, and a -1px inline margin collapses each pair of abutting borders into one hairline. Logical properties throughout, so a right-to-left locale rounds the correct ends with no second rule set.
caveats: Segments are separate buttons, so each still needs its own accessible name - an icons-only group without `aria-label` per button is three unnamed controls.
For a group where one segment is selected and stays selected, this is the wrong component: that is a radio group, and Tabs or the segmented rows in the Customize panel are the pattern.
support: Nothing newer than logical border-radius properties.
